title: Review restored caregiver sign-in, registration and profile setup
objective: Independently check the root agent's caregiver access form fix for functional errors and authentication regressions. Root owns all implementation writes.
acceptance_criteria: Buttons submit validated input through existing auth services
Provider and network failures are visible and retryable
Profile creation uses the signed-in credential and completes only after persistence
required_tests: Root supplies focused interaction test results; reviewer inspects code independently

result.summary: Root restored the empty sign-in, registration and profile setup handlers with validated forms. Independent read-only reviewer approved. Full frontend suite: 24 suites / 90 tests pass; focused tests: 9 pass; targeted lint and browser validation/navigation pass. Global typecheck retains six pre-existing FamilyMember errors. Root ACCEPT for the bounded UI fix; no claim of live account verification.
